status: Reviewed T4 and T17 against current paint/discovery/metric owners, direct checks, representative ownership contracts and retained native scopes.

inspected: Glyph paint retains logical source/object bounds separately from native drawing enclosure and filter-source visual bounds.
Solid/linear/radial/pattern fills and strokes retain enclosing, fragment and physical-font maps separately; object-box shaders bind the complete source text box.
Stroke construction borrows the existing glyph source and shared path/dash machinery, with independent font/device non-scaling width, caps/joins and paint order.
Decoration emission retains source-fragment order, line-through ordering and path placements; it lowers solid rectangles/outlines through existing scene owners.
Collapsed placement preserves effect anchors/object bounds while emitting no glyph paint; empty shader strokes do not shift surviving drawing enclosures.
directChecks: Matrix order and ULP texture/rounding boundaries, source/control object boxes and shared path layout.
Fill/stroke inheritance, dash/width/order/non-scaling contracts, invalid modes before acquisition, empty/zero outcomes and stroke-owner denial/cancellation/retry.
Decoration grammar, propagation and declaring paint ownership.
T4.nativeScope: Existing text-paint source/image/stage/precision/decoration banks, fractional strokes and source-instance compositions retain independent targets, source recipes and platform differences.

inspected: Direct/resource discovery preserves each live pattern/mask/marker context and restores traversal scopes; dormant, overridden and inactive sources do not acquire unnecessary programs.
Hidden/unpainted glyphs still supply advances to later painted spans. The shared SvgTextMetricScope retains active enclosing-filter bounds even when local paint is unavailable or placement collapses.
ClipMask purpose overrides ignored fill/stroke/filter paints while preserving typography and silhouette demand.
Device font-size precision, strike fitting, baseline rounding and filter/source bounds remain explicit stages; fitted font size alone does not choose the paint baseline.
Courier one-cell span widening is selected only by the exact embedded family metadata; catalog aliases cannot enable it for other bytes.
directChecks: Live/dormant instance and resource consumers, resource text inheritance, inactive target exceptions and source-independent filters.
Native small-strike execution/scanning, glyph texture/phase boundaries and exact embedded-family/alias guards.
Discovery/paint staging release on refusal or cancellation and remain retryable.
T17.nativeScope: Complete mask-text/resource-context documents, font-span metadata controls, filter-source images and retained source-instance compositions. Other font families retain their separate platform authority, including open Windows DejaVu.
